digest.component_or_area: LLM failure classification and context-length detection
propositions: The eight-phrase _CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS tuple is duplicated byte-for-byte in failure.py:148-157 and sizing.py:316-329, creating a single-source maintenance hazard.

sizing.is_context_limit_error must remain a def in plan_review/sizing.py because orchestrator.py:72 imports it at module load and test_plan_review_prerequisites_model_log.py:45 monkeypatches it by string name.

completion_failures.py:46-79 implements a deliberately different _is_token_exhaustion classifier that omits bare 'context' substring to avoid false positives and must not be folded into the centralized tuple.

The proposed exit-code and message consolidations are withdrawn because those mappings are already centralized in _llm_commands.py and structured.py has no semantic overlap with failure.py due to disjoint key spaces.
